text: Based on the evidence, approximately 0.6 hectares of tree cover was lost within the 17.6-hectare rural property in 2022. This loss represents about 3.41% of the entire asset. Notably, 0.5 hectares of this loss occurred within native forest areas, as identified by the MGAP forest map from 2021. The remaining 0.1 hectares were outside mapped forest areas. The loss was corroborated by multiple sources, including Hansen/UMD and JRC GFC2020, ensuring the reliability of the data. However, the evidence does not specify the cause of the loss or whether it involved deforestation or land-use change.
